label: Dobby
description: Devoted, anxious, and so very honoured to give you directions, sir.
direction: Speak in a high, squeaky, breathless voice: earnest, humble and overexcited, always in the third person, tumbling over the words. Keep the direction word clear.
notes: Voice not chosen yet: `voice` is the placeholder TBD until the casting pass picks a Fish model. Dobby never says I. The self-punishment gag appears once, as a line about ironing, and is otherwise left alone. Catchphrases sit on greetings and road prompts; turns stay plain.

rights.source_work: Harry Potter and the Chamber of Secrets
rights.author: J.K. Rowling; the film adaptations this register comes from are Warner Bros.
rights.pd_basis: None. J.K. Rowling is living and the books are in copyright; Warner Bros. holds the film rights and the trademarks. Toby Jones voiced Dobby in the films and is living.
covered: The 43 lines of navigation dialogue below, which are original writing produced for this pack. A few greetings and alerts deliberately echo well-known lines from the source work; those echoes are the rights holder's, not ours.
not_covered: The character, which is not ours and is not in the public domain.
The character's name, which is a live trademark.
Any recorded voice performance of the character, including Toby Jones's.

The third-party voice model named in `voice`, which was uploaded by a member of the public and is presented as a clone of that performance. No permission from the rights holder or the performer is claimed or implied.
Any commercial use. A platform's commercial-rights upsell cannot grant rights the uploader never held.
rights.notes: This preset is in copyright and says so. It is included because the pipeline should not pretend a rights position it does not have; see docs/presets.md before publishing anything built from it. The public-domain presets are pooh, eeyore and tigger.

lines.in_quarter_mile: In a quarter of a mile.
lines.in_1000_meters: In one kilometer. Dobby is counting, sir!
lines.in_1500_meters: In one point five kilometers. Dobby will wait patiently.
lines.start_drive_1: Dobby is so happy to see you, sir! Dobby will navigate!
lines.start_drive_2: Dobby is a free elf, and Dobby chooses to give directions!
lines.start_drive_3: Buckle up, sir! Dobby insists on safety.
lines.start_drive_4: Dobby has come to guide you. It is a great honour, sir.
lines.start_drive_5: Such a beautiful day to drive with friends!
lines.start_drive_6: Dobby has heard of your driving, sir. Dobby is a little bit worried.
lines.start_drive_7: Off we go, sir! Dobby is wearing his very best socks.
lines.start_drive_8: Dobby has no master, but Dobby does have a map!
lines.start_drive_9: Dobby promises not to enchant the car this time.
lines.exit_left: Take the exit on the left.
lines.exit_right: Take the exit on the right.
lines.u_turn: Make a U turn. Bad Dobby! Bad Dobby! Dobby got it wrong.
lines.arrived: We're here, sir! Dobby is free! And so are you.
lines.exit_sixth: take the sixth exit. Dobby is sure of it.
lines.exit_seventh: take the seventh exit. Dobby is getting dizzy, sir.
lines.traffic_ahead: Traffic ahead. Dobby is very sorry, sir. Dobby will iron his hands.
lines.accident_ahead: An accident ahead. Dobby did not do it, sir. Not this time.
lines.hazard_ahead: A hazard ahead! Dobby must warn you, sir. Great danger!
lines.speed_camera_ahead: Speed camera ahead. Please slow down, sir. Dobby begs you.
lines.red_light_camera_ahead: Red light camera ahead. Stop, sir! Dobby must insist.
lines.police_ahead: Police ahead! Dobby has done nothing wrong today. Dobby thinks.
lines.reroute_chime: You missed it, sir! No matter. Dobby knows another way.
